title: Healing Dew - Healing
text: Healing applies Instant Health II, restoring 8 health before spell-power bonuses and damaging undead instead. Delay changes it to Regeneration.
Spell power raises healing and Regeneration levels, not duration: 8 health corresponds to Regeneration I, and 12 to II. Delay controls duration.
Infusion adds brief Saturation to instant healing, or Resistance matching Regeneration's level and duration.
